expectedMetricRanges.notes: Release-facing professions must start with at most three learned profession talents.
At least 90% of terminal release-facing runs must confirm a non-starter rank 0 -> 1 learned talent event.
At least 75% of terminal release-facing runs must invest at least three points into two profession trees.
At least 75% of terminal release-facing runs with a breakpoint preview must confirm a breakpoint choice event.

notes: Phase4 v4 PR-01 owner baseline for profession tree run choice metrics.
The blocking denominator is limited to vanguard, arcanist, rogue, and templar.
